currency.title: Preferred currency
currency.hint: Used across investments, EMIs, and dashboards.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Switch the app between English and Bangla.

photo.removeBody: Your initial avatar will be shown instead.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enableIntro: Add a second sign-in step: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy. Enter your password to start.
twoFactor.disableIntro: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication. You'll only need your password to sign in.
twoFactor.setupIntro: Add Phinio to your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.scanQr: Or scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code didn't match. Check the time on your device and try again.
twoFactor.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few seconds and try again.
twoFactor.backupIntro: If you lose your authenticator app, each code signs you in once. Store them somewhere safe; you won't see them again.
twoFactor.fileHeader: Phinio backup codes. Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app.
twoFactor.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notifications.title: Payment reminders
notifications.hint: Get push notifications before EMIs and DPS installments are due.
notifications.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
notifications.denied: Blocked in browser settings. Re-enable there to turn on.
notifications.subscribed: You will be notified about upcoming and overdue payments.

danger.signOutMessage: Sign out of Phinio? You'll need to log in again next time.
danger.clearMessage: This permanently deletes all your investments, EMIs, deposits, withdrawals, and notifications. Your account and profile are kept — sign-in still works.
